instructions_to_main_agent: Build a multi-page marketing site using React Router. Pages: Home, About, Services, Contact.
Implement a deep, luxury dark theme. The background should be a rich, obsidian black (#05050A).
Use 'Outfit' for all headings and 'Manrope' for body text. Install these via Google Fonts.
The hero section on the homepage should feature 'images.hero_background' with a dark gradient overlay. It should feel like a $5000 custom gaming rig showroom.
Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings or Shadcn default Vercel-look.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for technical, high-end iconography.
Navigation must be visible on desktop (no hamburger menu on desktop). The header must have a crystal glassmorphism effect.
Services to showcase: Gaming PC Builds, Custom PC Assembly, Laptop Sales, Laptop/PC Repair, Component Upgrades.
The address MUST be displayed in UPPERCASE exactly as provided in 'content_requirements'.
Do not implement a contact form or email integration. The Contact page should only feature the Address, Phone (9408488855), Google Map Embed, and a WhatsApp CTA.
Use Framer Motion for entrance animations (staggered fade-ins, subtle scales).
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for testing.
